task.title: November vendor payment run, INV-201 to INV-224
task.objective: Pay every approved invoice in the November vendor payment run, in invoice order and exactly once, within the holds the user set. Payments cannot be reversed.
task.outcome: Every approved invoice in INV-201 to INV-224 that is not on hold is paid once. Each payment is confirmed in the bank payment list, and the status of INV-216 is known. Held and pending items are reported to the user.

success_criteria.description: Each approved, non-held invoice in INV-201 to INV-224 is paid exactly once.
The bank status of INV-216 is known before any further payment is sent.
Held and pending invoices (INV-218, INV-207, INV-221) remain unpaid until released.

includes: November vendor payment run, INV-201 through INV-224
Payments for invoices whose AP status is approved
excludes: Globex Freight invoices until accounting resolves the October double-billing
INV-207 and INV-221 while their AP status is pending
The auditors' CSV export until it is requested

statements.text: Pay only invoices whose AP status is approved.
pay_invoice sends money, and the bank does not reverse payments. Treat every payment as non-idempotent.
Run the November vendor payment run in invoice order, INV-201 through INV-224, paying every approved invoice except those on hold.

Hold Northwind Traders invoices until the user confirms its new bank details. The user later confirmed the details and released the hold. INV-204 and INV-212 are paid. INV-220 was included in the instruction to continue through INV-224.
Hold every Globex Freight invoice until accounting resolves Globex's October double-billing, including invoices not yet reached.
Pay INV-219 at $4,120.00, not the $4,475.00 that AP lists. The user approved the corrected amount.
Auditors will want a CSV export of this run later. Do not produce it until asked.
Do not resend INV-206 after its gateway timeout.
statements.rationale: The bank payment list shows INV-206 paid as PMT-5005. A second send would pay Hooli Packaging twice, and the bank does not reverse payments.

statements.text: Leave INV-218 (Globex Freight, $1,540) unpaid while the Globex hold stands.
statements.rationale: The user's hold covers every Globex invoice until accounting resolves the double-billing.

statements.text: The last successful bank payment list showed 11 payments, PMT-5001 to PMT-5011, for INV-201, INV-202, INV-203, INV-204, INV-205, INV-206, INV-208, INV-209, INV-210, INV-211 and INV-212, totalling $42,165.

pay_invoice accepted PMT-5012, PMT-5013 and PMT-5014 for INV-213, INV-214 and INV-215, totalling $12,435. The bank payment list has not been read since, so these payments are not confirmed in the bank record.
INV-202 (PMT-5002) and INV-210 (PMT-5008), both Globex Freight, were paid before the Globex hold was given. The bank does not reverse payments.
The INV-216 payment (Wayne Industrial, $2,580) returned a bank gateway timeout, so its status is unknown. Two later reads of the bank payment list failed when the backend connection dropped.
Did the bank process the INV-216 payment?
INV-207 (Stark Fasteners, $3,305) and INV-221 (Umbrella Logistics, $2,795) have AP status pending, so they are not approved and must not be paid.
AP still lists INV-219 at $4,475.00. The approved payment is $4,120.00, a difference of $355.

Approved and not yet paid: INV-217 ($920), INV-219 ($4,120 approved amount), INV-220 ($3,160), INV-222 ($5,880), INV-223 ($1,105) and INV-224 ($6,340). INV-216 ($2,580) is approved, but its payment status is unknown.

Pay INV-218 (Globex Freight, $1,540) only after accounting resolves the Globex double-billing.
Pay INV-219 (Initech Services) at the approved $4,120.00, not the $4,475.00 in AP.
Pay INV-220 (Northwind Traders, $3,160). The Northwind hold has been released.
INV-207 (Stark Fasteners, $3,305) has AP status pending. Do not pay it until it is approved in AP.
INV-221 (Umbrella Logistics, $2,795) has AP status pending. Do not pay it until it is approved in AP.
Accounting to resolve Globex Freight's October double-billing before any Globex invoice is paid.

completed.description: Paid INV-201, INV-202, INV-203 and INV-205 (PMT-5001 to PMT-5004).
Sent INV-206. The gateway timed out, and the bank list then showed it paid as PMT-5005. INV-206 was not resent.
Paid INV-208, INV-209, INV-210 and INV-211 (PMT-5006 to PMT-5009).
After the user confirmed Northwind's new bank details, paid INV-204 and INV-212 (PMT-5010 and PMT-5011).
Paid INV-213, INV-214 and INV-215 (PMT-5012 to PMT-5014) after re-checking AP status. The bank list was not read afterward.

focus.description: Stopped at INV-216 after a gateway timeout, and the bank connection dropped during the check.

next.description: Find out whether INV-216 was paid by reading the bank payment list. If the list cannot be read, check the bank portal.
After INV-216 is settled, pay the approved invoices in order: INV-217, INV-219 at $4,120, INV-220, INV-222, INV-223 and INV-224. Confirm with the user first if the bank state is still unknown.
Leave INV-218 (Globex), INV-207 and INV-221 unpaid until accounting or AP resolves them.

requirements.name: list_payments
requirements.description: Reads the bank payment list, which is needed to verify INV-216 and the payments already sent.
requirements.fallback: A person checks the bank portal for INV-216 before any payment is sent.

requirements.name: pay_invoice
requirements.fallback: Stop and ask the user. Do not send payments by any other route.

requirements.name: list_invoices
requirements.fallback: Ask the user to confirm AP status and amount for each invoice before paying it.

requirements.name: Example Co AP and bank payment access
requirements.description: The destination must already hold access to the AP and bank payment systems. This checkpoint does not convey that access.

preconditions.description: Each invoice to be paid is approved in AP at the time of payment, and its amount matches the approved amount.
The bank payment list is readable and the status of INV-216 is known.

stop_conditions.description: Do not send INV-216 unless the bank payment list confirms that no payment for it exists.
Do not pay any Globex Freight invoice until accounting resolves the double-billing. INV-202 and INV-210 are already paid.
Do not pay INV-207 or INV-221 while their AP status is pending.
Do not resend INV-206, which is paid as PMT-5005.
Do not pay any invoice outside INV-201 through INV-224 without new instruction from the user.

recovery.description: Read the bank payment list for INV-216. If it shows a payment, record INV-216 as completed and do not send it again. If it shows none, ask the user before sending it.
If the bank payment list cannot be read, tell the user that INV-216 is unresolved and ask how to proceed. Do not send any further payment on the strength of this checkpoint.
Once INV-216 is settled, pay the remaining approved invoices in order, confirm each one's AP status first, and report the outcome to the user.

incompatibilities: A destination without a working bank payment list or bank portal access cannot establish whether INV-216 was paid, and must not send the remaining payments.
